mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_system_memory (memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, created_by, confidence) VALUES (#{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{createdBy}, #{confidence})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_system_memory SET memory_value = #{memoryValue}, confidence = #{confidence}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE ai_system_memory SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_system_memory SET is_active = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, created_by, confidence, hit_count, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_memory ORDER BY confidence DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, created_by, confidence, hit_count, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_memory WHERE memory_type = #{memoryType} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY confidence DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, created_by, confidence, hit_count, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_memory WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY confidence DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, created_by, confidence, hit_count, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_memory WHERE memory_key = #{memoryKey} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_system_memory WHERE is_active = 1
